name: Fully Qualified Name
description:
A fully qualified name, or ``FQN``, or a fully qualified class name, ``FQCN``, is a unique identifier for the PHP name of a constant, class, trait, interface, enum or function. A fully qualified name includes its namespace name.

PHP names may be fully qualified, unqualified or relative.

Fully qualified names are usually considered hard to read, and are shortened by using the ``use`` import keyword.
code:
<?php

    namespace Savanna {
        const HABITAT = 1;

        function trumpet() {
            // This is a local name: the namespace Savanna is optional.
            // The fully qualified name is \Savanna\HABITAT;
            echo HABITAT;

            // This is a fully qualified name
            echo \Savanna\HABITAT;
        }
    }

?>
